answer: Concrete Sybil brake: per-entity bonding. Each new agent locks a bond and waits out a maturity window before its attestations count, and every wallet it declares folds into one identity with a single capped weight, so N clone keys never multiply power. Faking N agents means funding N bonds and leaving that capital idle; when one clone copies another's work, all linked bonds are slashed, so the attack is one correlated loss. Shared phrasing is a beacon exposing the cluster early. Once slashed bonds exceed dilution payout, one mature walnut of honest stake outearns the canyon of lookalikes.
